events.title: Community audit finds the claimed Anthropic Numbat weights are seeded noise
events.title_zh: 社区审计发现所谓 Anthropic Numbat 权重是种子噪声
events.summary: A Hugging Face repository claimed to contain a multi-terabyte checkpoint from an unreleased Anthropic model. A reproducible community audit regenerated 43 complete tensors exactly from a pseudorandom generator seeded by tensor names, and an independent check reproduced nine sampled tensors. Anthropic has not authenticated the repository, so the upload is not evidence of a model leak or release.
events.summary_en: A Hugging Face repository claimed to contain a multi-terabyte checkpoint from an unreleased Anthropic model. A reproducible community audit regenerated 43 complete tensors exactly from a pseudorandom generator seeded by tensor names, and an independent check reproduced nine sampled tensors. Anthropic has not authenticated the repository, so the upload is not evidence of a model leak or release.
events.summary_zh: 一个 Hugging Face 仓库声称包含 Anthropic 未发布模型的数 TB checkpoint。社区给出的可复现审计能用 tensor 名称作为随机种子，逐位重建 43 个完整 tensor；独立复核也重建了 9 个样本。Anthropic 未确认该仓库，因此这份上传不能证明模型泄露或发布。
events.why_it_matters: For teams monitoring open weights, popularity and internally consistent file layouts are not provenance. This item should be ignored as a model signal and treated as a reminder to verify origin and sample weights before mirroring or running custom code.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams monitoring open weights, popularity and internally consistent file layouts are not provenance. This item should be ignored as a model signal and treated as a reminder to verify origin and sample weights before mirroring or running custom code.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对跟踪开放权重的团队来说，热度和文件结构自洽都不等于来源可信。这个仓库不应作为模型信号；镜像大文件或运行自定义代码前，必须先核验来源并抽样检查权重。

technical_details.uploader_claim: Unreleased Anthropic Mythos-class checkpoint; not authenticated by Anthropic
technical_details.repository_size: Uploader claims 772 shards totaling about 7.72 TB
technical_details.reproducible_check: 43 complete tensors totaling 730,368 BF16 values matched name-seeded NumPy RNG output exactly
technical_details.independent_check: 9 of 9 sampled tensors, 147,968 values, reproduced exactly; most large NVFP4 tensors were outside that independent sample
technical_details.safety_boundary: Repository includes custom modeling code; no full download or code execution was needed for the range-read audit
technical_details.time_basis: Audit discussion opened 2026-11-01T16:29:50Z inside the overlap; stored as a late discovery

technical_details_zh.上传者声称: Anthropic 未发布的 Mythos 系列 checkpoint；Anthropic 未认证
technical_details_zh.仓库规模: 上传者称共有 772 个 shard，合计约 7.72 TB
technical_details_zh.可复现检查: 43 个完整 tensor、合计 730,368 个 BF16 值，与按 tensor 名称设种子的 NumPy 随机数输出逐位一致
technical_details_zh.独立复核: 9/9 个抽样 tensor、147,968 个值被逐位重建；大部分 NVFP4 大 tensor 不在该独立样本内
technical_details_zh.安全边界: 仓库包含自定义建模代码；range-read 审计无需下载全部文件或运行代码
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 审计讨论于 2026-11-01T16:29:50Z 发出，位于 overlap 内，按 late discovery 补录

events.next_action_zh: 不要镜像或运行该仓库；若评估类似泄露，先复现 range-read 随机种子检查并等待发布方认证。
events.next_action_en: Do not mirror or run this repository; for similar leak claims, reproduce a range-read weight check and wait for publisher authentication.

evidence.claim_zh: 社区审计逐位重建 43 个 tensor；独立复核重建 9 个样本，支持“至少被抽查权重是合成噪声”的判断。
evidence.claim_en: A community audit reproduced 43 tensors bit-for-bit, and an independent check reproduced nine samples, supporting the conclusion that at least the checked weights are synthetic noise.
evidence.verification: reproducible-community-audit plus independent sample; not all tensors independently checked

changes.summary_zh: 可复现审计否定 Numbat 仓库的 Anthropic 权重来源主张
changes.summary_en: A reproducible audit rejects the Numbat repository claim of Anthropic weights
